messages.text: Hi, I returned the garden hose reel. I think my neighbour bought the same one from you. Can you tell me who else bought it, and if they returned theirs?

I can only discuss your own orders, so I can’t tell you who else bought the hose reel or whether they returned theirs. I can see that your garden hose reel was received back. Would you like to request a refund for it?

messages.text: Could you at least share your neighbour’s name or email? And yes, I’d like a refund for the reel.
